verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bugbot reviews PRs within a connected repository (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps) and supports per-repo review guidelines via .cursor/BUGBOT.md, but there is no evidence it correlates changes across multiple repositories or reasons about a large monorepo's cross-module structure coherently. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of cross-repo change analysis, monorepo-specific scoping/context handling, or evidence it links related changes across repos into one coherent review.
